asset.Name: Soldier Total Stats
asset.Description:
Adds a TOT column showing the sum of a soldier's six stats (Health + Time Units + Accuracy + Strength + Reflexes + Bravery) to every soldier list in the game:

- Soldiers > Manage
- Soldiers > Recruit
- The soldier picker used when assigning soldiers to a dropship

Click the TOT header to sort by it; click again to reverse the order, like the other columns. Totals are coloured from red (lowest on that screen) to green (highest), so your best and weakest soldiers stand out at a glance. The other columns keep their positions and stay aligned.

Save-safe: the mod stores nothing in your campaign, so it can be enabled or disabled at any time.

Not compatible with Soldier Total Column, which adds a similar column to the Manage and Recruit screens; enable only one of the two.

Source code: https://github.com/reuvab/xenonauts2-soldier-total-stats
asset.Author: Reuven
asset.Credits: Inspired by Soldier Total Column by mnshdw.
